_doc: The applications the RADE page (index.html) offers. The page reads each application's RADE manifest from the main branch of its repository and offers the last bundle in it, so a new round needs no change here. ui = the UI standard the app's windows follow (docs/ui-standard.md; v1). help = the Teams channel name the page shows (the engine has the same name in $helpChannel, engine/rade_build.py: change both).
